work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act extends to the prior of San Venanzio, Camerino, the prelatial dress granted to the metropolitan chapter. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14741; own dating clause LF14841–14844 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo secundo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF14790 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
